question: Besides B.AI, which recurring company/platform promotions appear in our stored posts, and what existing storage could support cheap daily mention discovery?
authority: Read-only investigation. No classifier/software tests, provider/model calls, product code or schema changes, scheduling, blocklist changes, deployment, or database writes.
budget: At most eight read-only SQL requests, including errors/retries, with statement_timeout <=45s and one query running at a time. Discovery rankers followed by bounded candidate verification; no exhaustive spam-label claim.
method: Count distinct post IDs and authors per explicit body mention, independent of stored classes. Inspect examples before naming campaign candidates. Preserve B.AI overlap, tracked/untracked distinctions, and frequency-not-spam caveats.
coverage: Current persisted database only; shortened URL destinations and implicit/no-alias company mentions may be missing. Discovery top lists are capped; not an exhaustive company census.
